scopeChecklist: Crossref, OpenAlex, PubMed, and HAL use official APIs only.
PDFs can be imported from local folders, direct URLs, or linked scientific results.
Native extraction and OCR preview are both available depending on document quality.
Queries, imported records, and processed PDFs are stored locally.
FR and EN stay available across the UI.
